title: Clickable Zwischenbericht Table of Contents
description: Make each Inhaltsverzeichnis (TOC) entry in the Zwischenbericht a hyperlink that jumps exactly to the named section. The section-anchor label is already threaded into \SemioTableTocRow (print/tex/semio-table.sty) as its 3rd argument. Wrap all three cells (number, title, page) in \hyperref[label]{...}: number and title keep their current color (inner \textcolor overrides colorlinks), page number takes the semio-primary link color like the glossary. Guard on the label resolving so undefined refs degrade to plain text / "--". Whole-row clickable. Rebuild with --skip-nx-cache and verify links land on exact sections.
